newsitem.title: FINLAND: TT-TIETO SHARPLY UP ON H1-RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: TT-TIETO SHARPLY UP ON H1-RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in Finnish data systems and services group TT-Tieto rose to all-time highs on Thursday on H1 results near the top end of forecasts, brokers said.
At 1230/0930 GMT, TT-Tieto traded at 515.00, up 35.00 markka or 7.29 percent. Its previous life-high was 490.00 markka.
The company earlier reported pre-tax profit at 122.6 million markka against 85.2 million in the year-ago period. The range of forecasts in a Reuters poll had been 109-133 million markka.
"It's the sector of the future, one of the sexiest," one broker said. "520 markka is the top price today, another said.
